items.title: China’s new nightmare: a Japanese containment arc in the Indo-Pacific
items.summary:
Just weeks after US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping invoked their countries’ World War II alliance at the White House, Keen Sword 27 turned symbolism into hardware.
